caption:
When you go mountain biking in Costa Rica, you quickly learn that the topographic maps rarely tell the whole story. I design our routes to seek out these high-altitude ridges where the air is cool, the grass is thick, and the gradients demand your absolute focus. It is never just about the distance; it is about how we negotiate the terrain, shifting from a hard grind to a quiet pause just to take in the sheer scale of the cloud forest. This is the raw, unhurried pace of the highlands that we share with our guests at My Adventure Costa Rica.
